pattern: shared root implies same lexeme or meaning
detection: any curriculum claim or derived link asserting identity, sense or translation across words on the sole basis of a shared root
repo_invariant: root-sharing NEVER implies entry identity; occurrence_instantiates_lexeme ≠ realizes_form ≠ shares_root ≠ root_family_member are different edges

detection: any lesson-derived pattern applied to a token because its surface matches a taught example
repo_invariant: surface match NEVER authorizes reuse; the live norm_strict key drops person/voice/POS-distinguishing harakat, so a same-key set must be one word AND one person/POS before any surface generalization

pattern: one meaning of مَا applies globally
detection: any claim or link giving مَا (p099) a single function class outside an explicit per-occurrence analysis
repo_invariant: مَا has negation/relative/interrogative/masdariyyah readings; the 92:3:1 مَا row is owner-ledgered attributed-unresolved — a standing counterexample to any global assignment
enforcement: links to p099 carry function_class: unresolved_multifunction

detection: any claim that a morphological pattern (wazn) determines case, mood, function or governance at occurrences
repo_invariant: iʿrāb-bearing conclusions require two independent checks agreeing on conclusion AND reason; a wazn is sarf evidence only — nahw is decided per occurrence
enforcement: pilot fixtures include a pattern-lookalike adversarial row

detection: any vocabulary-row gloss projected onto an occurrence without contextual sense selection
repo_invariant: context decides multi-sense roots; the Qamus entry + nahw context select the sense; vocabulary tables are recall aids
enforcement: links never carry glosses — entry references only

pattern: a morphological candidate establishes an entry or sense
detection: any derived structure treating a generated/classified candidate as an entry, sense or certified fact
repo_invariant: candidate ≠ certified; only tools/certify_typed_fact.py certifies, with an evidence bundle on the correct ladder rung; this subtree contains ZERO certified rows
enforcement: every links row carries status: candidate
